small_guidance: Pass BLOCK_OC and BLOCK_SP as kwargs in the kernel launch (e.g., BLOCK_OC=32, BLOCK_SP=64) along with num_warps=4, num_stages=2. Add an @triton.autotune decorator over a few safe configs like (BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_SP) ∈ {(32,64),(64,32),(32,128),(64,64)} keyed on (OC, OD*OH*OW, IC*KD*KH*KW) so the launcher provides these constexprs automatically.
large_guidance: The current gather-based ConvTranspose3d loops over IC inside the innermost (kd,kh,kw) block and recomputes the same input index for every oc lane, which leaves a lot of arithmetic on the table. Redesign as an implicit-GEMM: M=OC, N=N*OD*OH*OW (or a tile thereof), K=IC*KD*KH*KW, with one program per (N-batch, OC-tile, spatial-tile) doing a tl.dot over K. Use channels_last-style packing for x and w, hoist the stride/pad index math out of the K loop, and fuse the BN scale/shift epilogue into the GEMM store. Then run a separate per-(N,C) reduction kernel for the spatial mean subtraction (or do a two-pass: first GEMM writes y, second kernel computes mean and subtracts).
